agent.name: extension-todo-context
agent.description: Read and manage session todos with todo_read, todo_write, bounded continuation, and /todo.

runtimeRequirements: completion-note exports current session todos as task-artifact Markdown
commands never infer a current task from todos or auto-sync task status
operator commands render typed Session todos views, short change receipts, warnings/errors, and bounded explicit Markdown export
/todo edit uses the official-signature input adapter; cancel and parse failure do not mutate session state
autoContinue is explicit through todo_write or /todo run and is disabled by /todo pause
agent_settled dispatches at most one hidden follow-up after recorded progress
missing progress, empty queues, transport failure, and a 20-continuation limit stop execution
/todo append accepts up to 20 atomic tasks separated by ;;
